question: Was this game decided by luck or by my choices?
answer: The game was decided much more by luck than by your choices. You lost Zamazenta and Great Tusk to a crit Ivy Cudgel and a 2HKO after Stealth Rock, and you missed a crucial Ceaseless Edge on Landorus while later getting a crit Knock Off and a crit Dragon Darts that both swung the endgame. Your own sequencing — e.g. Iron Defending Zamazenta into Landorus U-turn and Healing Wishing Enamorus into a dead Samurott — gave your opponent the openings those rolls exploited.
